reproduction.description: An existing quota_terminal account observation was overwritten to HEALTHY by a successful authentication-only probe even though the provider rejected the weekly quota.
reproduction.command: python3 -c '<isolated fixture: apply_failure(quota_terminal, retry_at=now+1day); apply_probe(claude_auth_status_refresh, ready=True)>'
reproduction.pre_fix_result: Before probe: DeliveryHealthState.RETRY_AFTER; After auth-only probe: DeliveryHealthState.HEALTHY (bug reproduced)
reproduction.post_fix_result: Before probe: DeliveryHealthState.RETRY_AFTER; After auth-only probe: DeliveryHealthState.RETRY_AFTER (preserved); After capacity-aware probe: DeliveryHealthState.HEALTHY (recovered)

provider_health_auth_only_probe_protecti.details: Added is_auth_only_probe helper identifying probes that verify credentials rather than model inference capacity (e.g. claude_auth_status_refresh, gemini_auth_material, copilot_auth_material, codex_auth_file, antigravity_auth_material). When an auth-only probe succeeds, apply_probe updates endpoint health to HEALTHY while preserving account quota and capacity state. In apply_failure and apply_probe, extracted and preserved quota_reset_at timestamps from provider failure details.

provider_permissions_capacity_probing.details: Extended _claude_auth_probe and probe_provider_auth with check_capacity parameter. When check_capacity=False (routine auth probe), only authentication is verified via OAuth refresh without consuming inference quota. When check_capacity=True, a non-persistent prompt probe is executed, correctly parsing weekly usage limits and extracting UTC quota reset timestamps.

supervisor_demanded_health_refresh.details: probe_demanded_delivery_health now accepts runtime state. When an account is in retry_after with quota or capacity failure, or holds a quota_reset_at timestamp, the refresh demand sets check_capacity=True so that the probe genuinely tests model capacity before clearing account gates.

account_scope_and_fallback.details: Preserved account scope and fallback semantics. When one Claude endpoint experiences quota exhaustion, the shared account claude-shared enters RETRY_AFTER, preventing fallback to other Claude endpoints (e.g. Claude2) on the same account while allowing fallback to distinct healthy accounts (e.g. Antigravity).

operator_zero_capacity_hold_preserved.details: Preserved explicit max_parallel=0 operator holds from PR #5938. Probes and expired retry timestamps never override configured zero capacity.

governance_and_scheduler_boundary.details: Used only existing TaskStore and provider health mechanisms. No new schedulers, daemons, or polling services added. Product code untouched.

verification.result: Ran 11 tests in 0.005s, OK (covers auth-only probe preservation, empty account behavior, capacity probe restoration, quota reset extraction from failure and probe)
Ran 5 tests in 0.007s, OK (covers auth-only vs check_capacity, prompt execution, quota detection, classification, reset parsing)
Ran 3 tests in 0.005s, OK (covers capacity-aware demanded refresh, fallback excluding exhausted shared account alias, operator zero-capacity hold)

rollout_and_activation.details: Source merge into dev alone is not live activation. Live supervisor must reload or restart with the merged command runtime to activate the updated provider_health and probe logic.
